title: Keto-friendly Jamaican Parmigiano-reggiano Stir-fry
description: A fresh and light dish featuring fresh herbs, keto-friendly cheese, and a vibrant kick from jerk seasoning to make a bold and adventurous meal.

ingredients.name: Jamaican jerk sauce (optional)
ingredients.notes: To add extra flavor and heat

instructions: Place chicken breasts on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Mix jerk seasoning, garlic, red bell pepper, green onions, and optional jerk sauce in a bowl. Season the chicken evenly with this mixture.
Bake for about 18-20 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
In a large skillet over medium heat, add olive oil and sauté fresh parsley until fragrant and slightly softened.
Add chicken slices to the skillet with herbs. Stir-fry for about 3-5 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with parmesan cheese shavings if desired.
Serve hot as a side dish or over cauliflower rice.
